versions.content: {DRAFT} If a filter action is applied on a Ethernet frame (i.e. stream), the corresponding EthSwtStreamFilterAction has an EthSwtStreamFilterActionDestinationPortModification configured and the EthSwtStreamFilterActionDestinationPortModificationType is set to ETHSWT_STREAM_EGRESS_DESTINATION_LIMIT , then the egress destination of this Ethernet frame shall be extended with the configured egress desti- nation (see EthSwtStreamFilterActionDestinationPortModificationE- gressPortRef , but limited to those referenced egress ports where this Ethernet frame is allowed to be transmitted according to the egress port state (e.g. VLAN mem- bership, assigned MAC address)).
